facts.business: Viji Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) engaged in lending activities.

auditor.name: Dharmendra K Agrawal & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Provision for standard asset lower than RBI prudential norms by 0.036%; repayment of loan accounts of three borrowers amounting to Rs. 145.47 Lac by director/guarantor Mr. Vijay Kothari, source of funds not independently verified, indicating potential stress and evergreening risk.

key_risks: Provision for standard assets lower than RBI prudential norms
Repayment of borrower loans by director/guarantor indicating potential stress and evergreening risk
facts.related_party_note: During the year, loan accounts of three borrowers amounting to Rs. 145.47 Lac were repaid by director Mr. Vijay Kothari who is also guarantor in the respective borrower accounts. The repayment was not made by the borrowers themselves and the source of funds of the guarantor has not been independently verified.
